name: reporter_cluster_bubble_handbook
description: Bubble family handbook: bubble (L1-L8), cs_bubble (L1-L6), labeled_bubble (L1-L5), cs_labeled_bubble (L1-L5) + 17 agg diversity. 41 layouts total.
source:
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
volume = src.v
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
vol_20 = stddev(period=20)(daily_ret)
rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
ts = index()

# ========================================================================
# BUBBLE (per-asset) L1-L8
# 250 rows per asset. First ~19 rows have null x (vol_20 needs 20-day warmup).
# Inputs: x=vol_20 (~0.004-0.017), y=daily_ret (~-0.021 to +0.036), z=volume (~1M-190M)
# ========================================================================

# DATA: Raw decimals. SPY last row: x=0.0060, y=-0.0029, z=122M
bubble(title='L1: Vol vs Return vs Volume', category='01 bubble L1: Basic'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Same as L1 but series='Risk-Return', color=Blue
bubble(title='L2: Risk-Return (Blue)', category='02 bubble L2: Color',
  series_name='Risk-Return', color=Color.Blue
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: x/y scaled x100 (PercentFormat). SPY last: x=0.60%, y=-0.29%, z=122M (z never scaled)
bubble(title='L3: Percent Axes', category='03 bubble L3: Percent',
  x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
  y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
  x_axis_label='Volatility', y_axis_label='Return'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Different inputs. x=RSI(~30-100 raw), y=close(~$380-580), z=volume. MonetaryFormat on y
bubble(title='L4: Price vs RSI', category='04 bubble L4: Monetary',
  y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, y_axis_dp=0,
  x_axis_label='RSI', y_axis_label='Close'
)(x=rsi_14, y=close, z=volume)

# DATA: Same raw decimals as L1. Sizing: width mode, min=4px, max=40% chart area
bubble(title='L5: Width Sizing', category='05 bubble L5: Sizing',
  min_size=4, max_size=40, size_by='width'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: x/y scaled x100 (both PercentFormat). Zero horizontal ref line on y axis
bubble(title='L6: With Thresholds', category='06 bubble L6: Ref Lines',
  y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
  x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
  reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
    ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)])
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: x/y scaled x100. Indigo bubbles, area-sized 6px-30%, zero ref line, order=1
bubble(title='L7: Full Config', category='07 bubble L7: Full',
  series_name='Full', color=Color.Indigo, min_size=6, max_size=30,
  size_by='area', x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
  y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
  x_axis_label='Volatility', y_axis_label='Return',
  reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
    ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)]),
  order=1
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: x/y scaled x10000 (BpsFormat). SPY last: x=60bps, y=-29bps, z=122M (z never scaled)
bubble(title='L8: BPS Format', category='07b bubble L8: BPS',
  y_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat, y_axis_dp=0,
  x_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat, x_axis_dp=0,
  x_axis_label='Vol (bps)', y_axis_label='Return (bps)'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# ========================================================================
# CS_BUBBLE (cross-sectional) L1-L6
# 750 rows (3 assets x 250 days). x=timestamp(epoch ms), y=daily_ret, z=|y| auto.
# One series per asset (DIA, QQQ, SPY). Bubble size = magnitude of return.
# ========================================================================

# DATA: 750 rows. y=raw daily_ret (~-0.025 to +0.036), z=|daily_ret|, x=timestamps
cs_bubble(title='L1: Return Magnitude', category='08 cs_bubble L1: Basic'
)(y=daily_ret)

# DATA: Same as L1. DIA=Blue, QQQ=Red, SPY=Green
cs_bubble(title='L2: Custom Colors', category='09 cs_bubble L2: Colors',
  colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Red, Color.Green]
)(y=daily_ret)

# DATA: y scaled x100 (PercentFormat, 2dp). y=0.40% to -1.00% range. z unchanged (raw)
cs_bubble(title='L3: Percent Format', category='10 cs_bubble L3: Percent',
  y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
  y_axis_label='Daily Return'
)(y=daily_ret)

# DATA: 500 rows (2 assets x 250). Filters to top 2 assets (DIA, QQQ). SPY excluded
cs_bubble(title='L4: Top 2 Assets', category='11 cs_bubble L4: Max Assets',
  max_assets=2
)(y=daily_ret)

# DATA: Same raw 750 rows. Width sizing: min=4px, max=40% chart area. order=2
cs_bubble(title='L5: Width Sizing', category='12 cs_bubble L5: Sizing',
  min_size=4, max_size=40, size_by='width',
  order=2
)(y=daily_ret)

# DATA: y scaled x100 (PercentFormat). Horizontal zero ref line divides +/- returns
cs_bubble(title='L6: With Zero Line', category='13 cs_bubble L6: Ref Lines',
  y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
  reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
    ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)])
)(y=daily_ret)

# ========================================================================
# LABELED BUBBLE (per-asset) L1-L5
# 2 rows per asset: '20-Day' and '50-Day' lookback windows.
# All use PercentFormat (x100). SPY: 20d(vol=0.60%,ret=0.21%,avgvol=82M)
#   50d(vol=0.75%,ret=0.20%,avgvol=81M). 50d slightly higher vol, similar return.
# ========================================================================
# Prepare values for labeled bubble (per-asset, explicit x,y,z triples)
ret_20 = sma(daily_ret, 20)
ret_50 = sma(daily_ret, 50)
vol_50 = stddev(period=50)(daily_ret)
avg_vol_20 = sma(volume, 20)
avg_vol_50 = sma(volume, 50)

# DATA: 2 points per asset. x/y scaled x100. Blue=20d, Gray=50d
labeled_bubble(
    title='L1: 20d vs 50d Lookback',
    category='14 labeled_bubble L1: Basic',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# DATA: Same 2 points. Blue diamond=20d, Orange triangle=50d
labeled_bubble(
    title='L2: Colored Points with Markers',
    category='15 labeled_bubble L2: Colors',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Orange, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleMarker)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# DATA: Same 2 points. Vertical x-ref at 1% vol, horizontal y-ref at zero return
labeled_bubble(
    title='L3: With Reference Lines',
    category='16 labeled_bubble L3: Ref Lines',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# DATA: Same 2 points. Width sizing 5px-25%. Larger avgvol = wider bubble
labeled_bubble(
    title='L4: Custom Sizing',
    category='17 labeled_bubble L4: Sizing',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    min_size='5',
    max_size='25%',
    size_by='width',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# DATA: Same 2 points. Full config: circle=20d Blue, square=50d Indigo, refs, 4px-20%, order=1
labeled_bubble(
    title='L5: Full Config',
    category='18 labeled_bubble L5: Full',
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='20-Day', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='50-Day', color=Color.Indigo, marker=MarkerSymbol.SquareMarker)
    ]),
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
    min_size='4',
    max_size='20%',
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(xyz_triples=(vol_20, ret_20, avg_vol_20, vol_50, ret_50, avg_vol_50))

# ========================================================================
# CS_LABELED_BUBBLE L1-L5
# 3 rows (one per asset), agg=Mean. x/y scaled x100 (PercentFormat).
# QQQ: vol=1.08%, ret=0.18%, vol=52M (highest risk+return)
# SPY: vol=0.79%, ret=0.09%, vol=82M (middle, largest volume = biggest bubble)
# DIA: vol=0.68%, ret=0.05%, vol=3.5M (lowest risk+return, smallest bubble)
# ========================================================================

# DATA: 3 labeled bubbles. Mean aggregation. Classic risk-return relationship
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L1: Risk vs Return vs Volume',
    category='19 cs_labeled_bubble L1: Basic',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Avg Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Same 3 rows but no 'name' column in Arrow output (data_labels=False)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L2: No Labels',
    category='20 cs_labeled_bubble L2: No Labels',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=False,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: 2 rows only (max_assets=2). DIA + QQQ kept. Custom colors Blue/Green/Orange
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L3: Colors + Top 2',
    category='21 cs_labeled_bubble L3: Colors',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Green, Color.Orange],
    max_assets=2,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Return'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: 3 rows. Width sizing 5px-25%. x-ref at 1% vol (vertical), y-ref at zero (horizontal)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L4: Ref Lines + Sizing',
    category='22 cs_labeled_bubble L4: Ref Lines',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    min_size='5',
    max_size='25%',
    size_by='width',
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Return'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: 3 rows. Full config: Blue/Red/Green, area 4px-20%, refs, dp=1/2, order=1
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='L5: Full Config',
    category='23 cs_labeled_bubble L5: Full',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Red, Color.Green],
    min_size='4',
    max_size='20%',
    size_by='area',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Return',
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.01, title='1% Vol', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# ========================================================================
# CS_LABELED_BUBBLE — AGG DIVERSITY (17 values)
# Each produces 3 rows (one per asset). All use raw DecimalValue (no format).
# Inputs: x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume. ~250 data points per asset aggregated.
# ========================================================================

# DATA: Cumulative sums. QQQ: x=2.49, y=0.45, z=13.1B | DIA: x=1.57, y=0.14, z=869M
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Sum',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Sum'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Final-day snapshot. DIA: vol=0.53%, ret=-0.04%, vol=3.4M
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Last',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Last'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Worst-case values. DIA: vol=0.48%, ret=-2.08%, vol=1.2M (all minimums)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Min',
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Min'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Best-case values. QQQ: vol=1.67%, ret=3.59%, vol=99M (all maximums)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Max',
    agg=AggregationType.Max,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Max'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Middle values. SPY: vol=0.76%, ret=0.08%, vol=79M. Close to Mean for symmetric data
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Median',
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Median'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Dispersion. QQQ: vol_std=0.0022, ret_std=0.0113, vol_std=12.8M (most volatile)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Std',
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Std'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Non-null counts. x=230 (vol_20 needs 20-day warmup), y=249, z=250 for all
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Count',
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Count'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: First-day values. SPY: vol=1.02%, ret=0.77%, vol=74.9M (day 1 of series)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: First',
    agg=AggregationType.First,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=First'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Boolean AND (all non-zero?). All x/z=1.0. SPY y=0.0 (has zero daily_ret day)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: All',
    agg=AggregationType.All,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=All'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Boolean OR (any non-zero?). All 1.0 for all assets/columns
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Any',
    agg=AggregationType.Any,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Any'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Unique value counts. x=231, y=250, z=250 (continuous data = nearly all unique)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: CountDistinct',
    agg=AggregationType.CountDistinct,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=CountDistinct'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Tail heaviness. QQQ vol_kurt=1.0 (heavy), DIA ret_kurt=0.18, SPY vol_z=3.59 (fat tails)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Kurtosis',
    agg=AggregationType.Kurtosis,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Kurtosis'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Most frequent value. Matches Min for continuous data (returns first min occurrence)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Mode',
    agg=AggregationType.Mode,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Mode'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: EMPTY — product of 250 daily returns underflows to 0, volume overflows to Inf. 0 charts produced.
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Product',
    agg=AggregationType.Product,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Product'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: 50th percentile (default q=0.5). Very close to Median. SPY: vol=0.76%, ret=0.07%
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Quantile',
    agg=AggregationType.Quantile,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Quantile'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Asymmetry. DIA vol_skew=0.72 (right-skewed vol), QQQ ret_skew=0.09 (near symmetric)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Skew',
    agg=AggregationType.Skew,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Skew'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)

# DATA: Variance. Very small for vol/ret (2e-6, 5e-5). Huge for volume z (1.2e11 to 4.7e14)
cs_labeled_bubble(
    title='Agg: Var',
    agg=AggregationType.Var,
    category='AD cs_labeled_bubble agg=Var'
)(x=vol_20, y=daily_ret, z=volume)
